name: 'Speed of Light'
description:
He needs some rest. 
Let him speed up.

Let it blow the dust of space.

Third piece of 'Silver Surfer' series.

name: 'Spacewalker'
description:
It has all begun. The inevitable is about to come, and it is not the same thing as it was before. Not so restless but rather mindless now. The steps of it can be found anywhere. Spacewalker is not somewhere, it's everywhere. It set foot on the places you don't even think that exist. Yet, you do not have to resist. Even the stars admire its presence.

The Sun despises him as Spacewalker is brighter with the light, the source of which is the Sun itself.

Second piece of 'Silver Surfer' series.

6250x6250

name: 'Cosmic Power'
description:
Cosmic Power runs through the body of this unknown being. It overloads. Space is his playground, and it wanders around. He's lost, and nowhere to be found. After Galactus set eye on its planet, there was nothing to do but to leave. 

Though seems to be mindless  
It remains to be just restless. 
He not only wanders but also questions... 
The depth of space, wishing to find its way. 
Cries in silver  
Unfortunately it shivers. 

First piece of 'Silver Surfer' series.
